captures.description: THE BOSSWARE AND EMPLOYMENT TECH DATABASE, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The Coworker.org Bossware and Employment Tech Database catalogs more than 550 labor-focused technology products used to monitor, track, and manage workers across various industries.' A definition of bossware (from the New York Times card), four kinds of feature, eleven named products in three groups, and Vanderbilt Law School's research on data sharing. Eight cards: Coworker's own page, Vanderbilt, the New York Times and five videos or posts.
